description: This file defines a cache class for timezone options, including functions to generate display names for timezones based on offsets and daylight saving time, and manages asynchronous computation and caching of timezone options.

classes.name: TimezoneOptionsCache
classes.description: A class that caches and asynchronously computes timezone options for display purposes.

methods.name: getOffsetKey
methods.description: Generates a key based on the UTC offsets of a timezone during January and July to distinguish timezones with different daylight saving rules.

methods.name: getTimezoneDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name for a timezone, considering daylight saving time status.

methods.name: isCached
methods.description: Checks if timezone options are already cached.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns cached timezone options if available.

methods.name: computeOptions
methods.description: Computes the list of timezone options, including labels with GMT offsets and display names.

methods.name: getOptionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously computes and retrieves timezone options, utilizing caching and microtask scheduling.
